About Breaking the Shell

RedQuadrant developed Breaking the Shell for groups working on a change. Participants name what might stop them and decide who can do something about each obstacle. Breaking the Shell Ltd presents the browser version.

Privacy and storage

The exercise saves your notes in this browser on this device. You can reopen it here without an account. Anyone with access to the same browser profile can see the notes. Choose ‘Print / save PDF’ to keep a copy, or ‘Clear this exercise’ to erase the entries. Clearing your browser data can also remove them.

There are no analytics or advertising scripts. The hosting service handles technical request information needed to serve and protect the site. Email enquiries go to the mailbox you choose.

Reuse

The original overview specifies Creative Commons reuse with attribution, without identifying a version. Credit RedQuadrant and retain the source notice. The new browser code is provided under the MIT licence, included in the source. Third-party material is not relicensed.
